title: Check Current Zone Configuration Using “Get Zone Configuration” (Zone Config Aveva API page)
summary: Use the Zone Config Aveva API page’s “Get Zone Configuration” function to retrieve the current lane-to-zone configuration and confirm that lane assignments, zones, and processing sequence numbers are present and populated.
when_to_use: When you need to verify the current zone configuration returned by the Zone Config interface—specifically that all lanes have assigned zones and processing sequence numbers populated.
not_for: Do not use this procedure to perform zone changes. “Update Zone Configuration” is a separate action and is not covered here.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the “Get Zone Configuration” fetch and validate that the returned configuration is complete (lanes present) and populated (zone and processing sequence values present).
safety_notes: Avoid using “Update Zone Configuration” during this diagnostic unless explicitly authorized by the playbook/SME (it is described as allowing users to modify zone settings).
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the “Zone Config Aveva API page” interface
Ability to view the “Get Zone Configuration” results payload/table

access_required: Zone Config Aveva API page access (Aveva HMI / API page interface)

visual_references.description: Zone Config Aveva API page interface showing lane assignments, zones, processing sequence numbers, and the “Get Zone Configuration” control.
Zone Config Aveva API page interface context for navigating to the page and viewing the lane/zone/processing sequence display area.

steps.title: Open the “Zone Config Aveva API page” interface
steps.purpose: Get to the interface that provides visibility into lane assignments, zones, and processing sequence numbers.
steps.instruction: Open the “Zone Config Aveva API page” interface.
steps.expected_result: The Zone Config Aveva API page is displayed with the “Get Zone Configuration” function available and an area that presents lane assignments, zones, and processing sequence numbers.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the “Get Zone Configuration” control and the lane/zone/processing sequence display area on the Zone Config Aveva API page.
steps.failure_condition: The “Get Zone Configuration” control is not available, or the page does not show the lane/zone/processing sequence display area.

actions.label: Verify page loaded
actions.exact_action: Open the “Zone Config Aveva API page” interface.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Zone Config Aveva API page includes “Get Zone Configuration” to fetch current configuration of all lanes, showing lane assignments, zones, and processing sequence numbers.

steps.title: Run “Get Zone Configuration” to fetch current lane configuration
steps.purpose: Retrieve the current configuration of all lanes from the Zone Config interface.
steps.instruction: Click/select “Get Zone Configuration” to fetch the current configuration of all lanes.
steps.expected_result: A fetch is performed and results are returned for the lane configuration (lane assignments with their respective zones and processing sequence numbers).
steps.healthy_condition: The fetch completes and returns a non-empty configuration for lanes.
steps.failure_condition: The fetch fails or returns incomplete/empty results.

actions.label: Fetch zone configuration
actions.exact_action: Click/select “Get Zone Configuration” to fetch the current configuration of all lanes.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Get Zone Configuration” fetches the current configuration of all lanes, offering visibility into how each lane is set up within the system.

steps.title: Validate returned lane assignments, zones, and processing sequence numbers
steps.purpose: Confirm the configuration is complete and populated for each lane.
steps.instruction: Observe the returned results and confirm that each lane has a zone and a processing sequence number populated.
steps.expected_result: The “Get Zone Configuration” fetch returns a non-empty configuration for all lanes, with each lane showing its respective zone and processing sequence number.
steps.healthy_condition: Results include entries for the expected set of lanes (not empty/missing), and for each lane the zone and processing sequence number fields are populated (not null/blank).
steps.failure_condition: Results are missing lanes, or show null/blank zone values or null/blank processing sequence number values.

actions.label: Check completeness and field population
actions.exact_action: Confirm the response includes entries for the expected set of lanes and that each lane has a zone and processing sequence number populated.

stop_or_escalate_if: Processing sequence number values are null/blank

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Zone Config Aveva API page provides an overview of lane assignments, their respective zones, and the processing sequence numbers; “Get Zone Configuration” fetches the current configuration of all lanes.

success_criteria: “Get Zone Configuration” returns a non-empty configuration for lanes.
Each lane entry includes a populated zone value and a populated processing sequence number.
healthy_conditions: Results are non-empty and include entries for the expected set of lanes.
No lane shows null/blank zone values.
No lane shows null/blank processing sequence number values.
failure_conditions: Fetch fails or indicates an error/failed fetch.
Null/blank zone values for one or more lanes.
Null/blank processing sequence number values for one or more lanes.
escalation_guidance: Escalate if the fetch fails or returns incomplete data (missing lanes, blank/null zone values, or blank/null processing sequence numbers).

If the issue appears to require changing zone settings, note that “Update Zone Configuration” is a separate (higher-risk) action and should not be performed unless explicitly authorized by the playbook/SME.
